# githubsettings_repository_workflow_permissions (Resource)

Manages the default GitHub Actions workflow permissions for one repository. Creating or updating this resource applies the configured permissions to GitHub; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state without changing them. Requires a token with repository administration write access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_workflow_permissions" "example" {
  owner                            = "example-owner"
  repository                       = "example-repository"
  default_workflow_permissions     = "read"
  can_approve_pull_request_reviews = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `can_approve_pull_request_reviews` (Boolean) Allow GitHub Actions to approve pull request reviews.
- `default_workflow_permissions` (String) Default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions for workflows. Allowed values are read, write.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import githubsettings_repository_workflow_permissions.example example-owner/example-repository
```
